Further all schemes sanctioned by BIFR are saved and would continue to be enforceable by NCLT.

Modi Marco Aldany Private Limited (MMAPL) was incorporated pursuant to a joint venture arrangement between Modi Rubber Limited and Alma Beauty Corporation S.L., Spain, with both parties holding 50% each.
MMAPL was established with the objective of carrying on the salon and beauty business under the 'Marco Aldany' brand.
From around FY 2019-20 onwards, business operations of MMAPL were adversely affected due to COVID-19 pandemic and deterioration in business environment.
Alma Beauty Corporation S.L. subsequently discontinued/shut down its overseas business operations and expressed intention to discontinue the joint venture and wind up MMAPL.
At present, one salon operated under MMAPL is situated in the corporate building of the Company and is presently operational.

The Board of Directors at its meeting held on 14 August 2026 approved the proposal for alteration of the Object Clause of the Memorandum of Association to enable the Company to undertake salon and allied business.
Mr. Alok Modi is also the Managing Director of Gujarat Guardian Limited and drawing remuneration from Gujarat Guardian Limited.
Mr. Alok Modi opted not to draw remuneration from the company so long as company continues to implement the unimplemented portion of the BIFR scheme.
Mr. Alok Modi shall be entitled for reimbursement of all expenses incurred or to be incurred in India or abroad for Company's business during his tenure as Managing Director.
As Mr. Alok Modi is a Foreign National, his Re-appointment will require approval from the Central Government.
